fields.name: Final_Status
fields.expression:
IIF(
    ISNULL(Aadhar_Status) AND Ekyc_Status <> 'P',
    'Aadhar and EKYC both are not verified',
IIF(
    ISNULL(Ekyc_Status) AND Aadhar_Status = '1',
    'Aadhar is verified but EKYC is not verified',
IIF(
    ISNULL(Ekyc_Status) AND ISNULL(Aadhar_Status),
    'Aadhar and EKYC both are not verified',
    IIF(
        ISNULL(Ekyc_Status) AND Aadhar_Status <> '1',
        'Aadhar and EKYC both are not verified',

        IIF(
            Aadhar_Status = '1' AND Ekyc_Status = 'A',
            'Aadhar is verified but EKYC is not verified',
            IIF(
            Aadhar_Status <> '1' AND Ekyc_Status <> 'P',
            'Aadhar and EKYC both are not verified',
 IIF(
            Aadhar_Status <> '1' AND Ekyc_Status = 'P',
            'Aadhar is not verified but EKYC is verified',

            IIF(
                Aadhar_Status = '1' AND Ekyc_Status <> 'P',
                'Aadhar is verified but EKYC is not verified',
                IIF(
                Aadhar_Status = '1' AND Ekyc_Status = 'P',
                'Aadhar and EKYC both are verified',
IIF(
                        Aadhar_Status = '0' AND Ekyc_Status = 'P',
                        'Aadhar is not verified but EKYC is verified',

                    IIF(
                        Aadhar_Status = '0' AND Ekyc_Status <> 'P',
                        'Aadhar and EKYC both are not verified',
                        ''
                    )
                )
            )
        )
    )
)
)
)
)
)
)
